audience.text: Developers building .NET applications targeting netcoreapp3.1, net6.0, net8.0, or net10.0 who need to programmatically create, modify, and convert 3D scenes.

capabilities.text: Build and manage 3D scene graphs using Scene and Node classes, supporting hierarchical organization with root and child nodes.
capabilities.title: Scene graph construction

capabilities.text: Construct primitive shapes like Box, Cylinder, Sphere, and IFC-compatible 2D profiles such as LShape, TShape, and RectangleShape.
capabilities.title: Primitive and profile geometry

capabilities.text: Assign shading materials including LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, PbrMaterial, and ShaderMaterial to nodes.
capabilities.title: Material assignment

capabilities.text: Animate scenes using AnimationClip, AnimationChannel, KeyFrame, Bone, Skeleton, SkinDeformer, and MorphTargetDeformer.
capabilities.title: Animation support

capabilities.text: Convert 3D scenes between FBX, glTF, OBJ, STL, COLLADA, 3MF, PLY, and other supported formats using Scene.FromFile() and Scene.Save().
capabilities.title: Format conversion

capabilities.text: Define NURBS curves and surfaces using NurbsCurve and NurbsSurface with control points, weights, and knot vectors.
capabilities.title: NURBS support

capabilities.text: Read and write per-vertex mesh data including normals, UVs, vertex color, tangent/binormal, smoothing groups, and user data.
capabilities.title: Vertex data handling

limitations.text: Rendering is not implemented; Scene.Render and related APIs throw NotImplementedException.
PolygonModifier and most TriMesh helpers throw NotImplementedException; mesh post-processing utilities are not functional.
NURBS evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion throw NotImplementedException despite data construction support.
PLY import/export works via Scene.Open/Save but direct use of PLYFormat class throws NotImplementedException.
PDF and Google Draco import/export are not functional; no reader/writer implementations exist.
3MF build metadata and RVM attribute loading are not implemented despite core geometry support.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic construction and conversion of 3D scenes using pure managed code with no native dependencies.
Supports reading and writing multiple 3D interchange formats including FBX, glTF, OBJ, STL, COLLADA, 3MF, and PLY.
Provides a consistent API surface compatible with Aspose.3D for .NET Enterprise Edition for code portability.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source MIT-licensed .NET library for building, traversing, and converting 3D scenes without external 3D engines.

workflows.name: Build a scene from primitives
workflows.text: Create a scene with a root node, add child nodes with primitive geometry like Box or Cylinder, assign materials, and save to FBX.

workflows.name: Load and convert between formats
workflows.text: Load an existing scene using Scene.FromFile() and save it in another format like OBJ using Scene.Save() with appropriate FileFormat constants.

workflows.name: Traverse node hierarchy
workflows.text: Access and iterate through the node hierarchy of a loaded scene starting from RootNode.

workflows.name: Assign and convert materials
workflows.text: Assign shading materials such as LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes independently of geometry.
